row.evidence: Frame.io's pricing page lists SAML2-based SSO only on the Custom-priced Enterprise plan; Enterprise accounts are managed in the Adobe Admin Console, whose Microsoft Entra ID Sync "uses the SCIM protocol" and whose Entra/Google connectors apply to "Adobe enterprise customers".
row.notes: Unchanged status. Team-plan price corrected to the annual figure: Pro $156/yr ($13/member/mo; $15 monthly), Team $264/yr ($22/mo; $25 monthly), Free up to 2 members, Enterprise Custom. SCIM is not Frame.io's own endpoint: Frame.io Enterprise users are managed in the Adobe Admin Console, which accepts SCIM from Microsoft Entra ID (gallery app "Adobe Identity Management (SAML)") and Google Workspace (Google Sync), both requiring a federated directory and Adobe enterprise products. Removed users are disabled, not deleted, by default. No Okta SCIM path (Okta OIN Frame.io app is SWA only). Admin Console also offers CSV bulk upload, the User Sync Tool and the User Management REST API. Frame.io V4 API exposes account user roles; its plan availability is stated inconsistently.

deprovision.data_retained: User is Disabled (no SSO login or licence access); cloud-stored assets remain. Permanent removal needs manual deletion after enabling editing of synced users.

roles.how: Frame.io account role (Content Admin or Member) is set when adding users in Admin Console; not documented as a SCIM attribute.

limitations.text: SCIM targets the Adobe Admin Console, not Frame.io directly; only Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace connectors are documented, and both need a federated directory and Adobe enterprise products.
Existing Frame.io V4 and Legacy (V3) Enterprise customers must contact their account team to move user management to Admin Console.
Entra sync cannot run alongside the User Sync Tool or UMAPI; nested groups must be added to scope separately; cycles run about every 40 minutes.
Synced Adobe user groups only include members holding a Frame.io licence on the account.

endpoints.purpose: Update user role for the account
Update user role in a workspace
Remove a user from a workspace

rate_limits.text: Per endpoint per account_user, e.g. list account users 100/min, update account role 10/min.

limitations.text: Server-to-server (service account) auth is only for V4 accounts administered via the Adobe Admin Console.
No account-level invite or remove-user endpoint was seen in the V4 API index; account membership is managed in the Admin Console.

entra.notes: Gallery app "Adobe Identity Management (SAML)" provisions users and groups into the Adobe Admin Console (Settings > Directory Details > Sync > Sync users from Microsoft Azure) with a tenant URL and secret token.

google.notes: Adobe documents Google Sync (SCIM from Google Workspace) for federated directories; Google's own catalogue page for Adobe not loaded.

fallbacks.other_sync: Adobe User Sync Tool (LDAP) and User Management REST API via Admin Console
fallbacks.notes: Frame.io's SSO article says users must be invited before they sign in (no JIT), but it describes the Frame-managed SAML setup, not Admin Console federated IDs.
